facts.label: Where
facts.value: In Africa and across the diaspora in Europe

about.p1: GEK INNOVATECH is a web agency based in Benin. We build professional websites for shopkeepers, entrepreneurs, freelancers and associations, in Africa and across the diaspora in Europe.
about.p2: The way we work comes down to three commitments: a fixed price announced before we start, from {{min}} to {{max}} depending on the plan; a stated timeline, from 1 week; and a direct contact on WhatsApp, from the first message to the follow-up after launch.
about.p3: At <brand>GEK INNOVATECH</brand>, we also develop mobile apps, work on your Google search ranking, and take care of your site's hosting, maintenance and security.
about.p4: Every site is designed for the phone first, because that is often where your customers find you.
